activity_statements.statement: provides disaster relief and recovery services to families and communities affected by emergencies across the United States and internationally
collects, processes and distributes blood and blood products to hospitals and medical facilities as a major US blood supply operator
trains individuals and organizations in health and safety including CPR, first aid, lifeguarding, and emergency response through certification courses
delivers international humanitarian aid, development programs and emergency response in partnership with the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement
provides emergency communications, financial assistance and support services to US military service members, veterans and their families

name_reality_gap: Labeled Nonprofit Organizations; what the evidence shows is that the Red Cross is simultaneously the US's largest blood supply operator (biomedical logistics), a national emergency-response infrastructure provider, and a safety-training certification business — none of which are obvious from nonprofit label.
extraction_notes: Good single source. Blood services represent ~40% of Red Cross revenue per public filings (well known), making it a significant biomedical logistics operation beyond the humanitarian framing. Extraction limited to about page; financial breakdown not sourced.
